name: return-to-archive-sac-recover-draw
notes: Return to the Archive (aIbBhTilEN, GeneratedMacroCode.php cardActivatedAbilities["aIbBhTilEN:0"] / customDQHandlers["ReturnToArchiveProcess"]): "You may sacrifice a regalia. If you do, recover 2 and draw a card." A Poisoned Dagger regalia is seeded on the field and the champion is pre-damaged (Damage=5). Playing the card (2 reserve) offers an MZMAYCHOOSE to sacrifice a regalia; choosing it recovers 2 (Damage 5 -> 3) and draws a card. The sacrificed regalia lands in myBanish rather than myGraveyard -- this is GraveyardAddReplacement's generic engine rule (GameLogic.php ~17765: any REGALIA card being added to a graveyard is transparently redirected to banish instead), not specific to this card. Break/restore verified: commenting out the RecoverChampion() call in ReturnToArchiveProcess leaves the champion's Damage at 5 and the fixture fails; restoring it passes again.

rulesClauses: You may sacrifice a regalia. If you do, recover 2 and draw a card.
